```{python}
# Define the folder path
folder_path = "data"

# Function to read CSV with encoding handling
def read_csv_with_encoding(file_path):
    try:
        return pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="utf-8")  # Try UTF-8 first
    except UnicodeDecodeError:
        return pd.read_csv(file_path, encoding="ISO-8859-1")  # Fallback to ISO-8859-1

# Load CSV files with error handling
dT = read_csv_with_encoding(os.path.join(folder_path, "us_jwc_classified.csv"))
```

# Number of Journey Types with children u10y/ 10-17y/ 0-17y
```{python}
# Ensure numeric child counts (coerce bad values to 0)
dT = dT.copy()
for col in ["PartyNumu10", "PartyNum1017"]:
    dT[col] = pd.to_numeric(dT[col], errors="coerce").fillna(0)

# Per-tour aggregation
tour_counts = (
    dT.groupby(["TOURID", "JourneyWithChildren"], dropna=False)
      .agg(
          u10_per_tour=("PartyNumu10", "sum"),
          a10_17_per_tour=("PartyNum1017", "sum"),
      )
      .reset_index()
)
tour_counts["a0_17_per_tour"] = tour_counts["u10_per_tour"] + tour_counts["a10_17_per_tour"]

# TABLE 1: Crosstab of per-tour child counts vs JourneyWithChildren
table1 = (
    tour_counts.pivot_table(
        index=["u10_per_tour", "a10_17_per_tour", "a0_17_per_tour"],
        columns="JourneyWithChildren",
        values="TOURID",
        aggfunc="nunique",
        fill_value=0,
    )
    .sort_index()
)

# TABLE 2: Frequency of JourneyWithChildren
table2 = (
    tour_counts["JourneyWithChildren"]
    .value_counts(dropna=False)
    .sort_index()
    .rename_axis("JourneyWithChildren")
    .to_frame("TourCount")
)

print("\n=== Table 1: Crosstab ===")
print(table1)
print("\n=== Table 2: Counts ===")
print(table2)
```

#older in couple/ younger in couple
```{python}
# --- 0) Keep a copy of the original table (trip- or person-level) ---
dT = dT.copy()

# --- 1) Coerce needed fields to numeric ---
for c in ["R_RELAT", "R_AGE_IMP", "LIF_CYC"]:
    dT[c] = pd.to_numeric(dT[c], errors="coerce")

# --- 2) Build a PERSON-LEVEL view from dT (handles trip-level too) ---
persons = (
    dT[["HOUSEID","PERSONID","R_RELAT","R_AGE_IMP","LIF_CYC"]]
      .drop_duplicates(["HOUSEID","PERSONID"])
)

# --- 3) Identify one SELF and one SPOUSE per household ---
selfs = (
    persons.loc[persons["R_RELAT"] == 1, ["HOUSEID","PERSONID"]]
           .drop_duplicates("HOUSEID")
           .rename(columns={"PERSONID":"SELF_ID"})
)
spouses = (
    persons.loc[persons["R_RELAT"] == 2, ["HOUSEID","PERSONID"]]
           .drop_duplicates("HOUSEID")
           .rename(columns={"PERSONID":"SP_ID"})
)

pairs = selfs.merge(spouses, on="HOUSEID", how="inner")

# --- 4) 2-category COUPLE/SINGLE at person-level ---
# Mark partner PERSONIDs (only those in a couple household)
roles_long = pd.concat(
    [
        pairs[["HOUSEID","SELF_ID"]].rename(columns={"SELF_ID":"PERSONID"}),
        pairs[["HOUSEID","SP_ID"]].rename(columns={"SP_ID":"PERSONID"}),
    ],
    ignore_index=True
).drop_duplicates()

roles_long["CoupleStatus"] = "Couple"

# Merge to persons
persons = persons.merge(roles_long, on=["HOUSEID","PERSONID"], how="left")

# Your Single rule (respondent R_RELAT==1 with LIF_CYC in {3,5})
persons["Single"] = ((persons["R_RELAT"] == 1) & (persons["LIF_CYC"].isin([3,5]))).astype("Int64")

# Fill default status
persons["CoupleStatus"] = persons["CoupleStatus"].fillna("Single")

# If Single by definition, force status/flag
persons.loc[persons["Single"] == 1, "CoupleStatus"] = "Single"

# Binary flag
persons["COUPLE"] = (persons["CoupleStatus"] == "Couple").astype("Int64")

# Optional: categorical
persons["CoupleStatus"] = pd.Categorical(persons["CoupleStatus"], categories=["Couple","Single"], ordered=False)

# --- 5)  Propagate person labels back to dT (trip-/row-level) ---
dT = dT.merge(
    persons[["HOUSEID","PERSONID","CoupleStatus","COUPLE","Single"]],
    on=["HOUSEID","PERSONID"], how="left"
)

# --- 6) TOUR-LEVEL label from person labels (2 categories) ---
if "TOURID" not in dT.columns:
    raise KeyError("TOURID column not found in dT")

tour_keys = ["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TOURID"]

# Diagnostic: mixed-person tours (should be zero)
mixed_tours = (
    dT.groupby(["HOUSEID","TOURID"])["PERSONID"].nunique()
      .reset_index(name="n_persons_in_tour")
)
n_mixed = int((mixed_tours["n_persons_in_tour"] > 1).sum())
if n_mixed > 0:
    print(f"WARNING: {n_mixed} tours contain trips from multiple PERSONID. "
          "TourCoupleStatus will be set to the modal value within the tour.")

# Work on tiny frame to avoid suffix collisions
tmp = (
    dT[tour_keys].dropna(subset=["TOURID"]).drop_duplicates()
      .merge(
          persons[["HOUSEID","PERSONID","CoupleStatus"]],
          on=["HOUSEID","PERSONID"], how="left", validate="m:1"
      )
)

def _mode_or_first(vals):
    vals = [v for v in vals if pd.notna(v)]
    if not vals:
        return pd.NA
    counts = {}
    order = []
    for v in vals:
        if v not in counts:
            counts[v] = 0
            order.append(v)
        counts[v] += 1
    return max(order, key=lambda k: counts[k])

tour_status = (
    tmp.groupby(tour_keys, as_index=False)["CoupleStatus"]
       .agg(TourCoupleStatus=_mode_or_first)
)

tour_status["TourCoupleStatus"] = pd.Categorical(
    tour_status["TourCoupleStatus"], categories=["Couple","Single"], ordered=False
)

# Merge back to trips
dT = dT.merge(
    tour_status[["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TOURID","TourCoupleStatus"]],
    on=["HOUSEID","PERSONID","TOURID"], how="left", validate="m:1"
)

# --- 7) Sanity checks ---
print("PERSON-LEVEL distribution:")
print(persons["CoupleStatus"].value_counts(dropna=False))

print("\nTRIP-/ROW-LEVEL distribution (CoupleStatus):")
print(dT["CoupleStatus"].value_counts(dropna=False))

print("\nTOUR-LEVEL distribution (TourCoupleStatus):")
print(tour_status["TourCoupleStatus"].value_counts(dropna=False))
```

```{python}
def _mode_or_first(vals):

    counts = {}
    order = []
    for v in vals:
```

# Travel time in minutes (travel time + activity time = total tour duration) - less than 12 H
```{python}
# --- 1) Ensure numeric (keeps leading zeros irrelevant because we convert properly)
dT["STRTTIME"] = pd.to_numeric(dT["STRTTIME"], errors="coerce")
dT["ENDTIME"]  = pd.to_numeric(dT["ENDTIME"],  errors="coerce")

# --- 2) Converter from HHMM (0000–2359) to minutes since midnight
def hhmm_to_minutes(x):
    if pd.isna(x):
        return np.nan
    x = int(x)
    hh, mm = divmod(x, 100)
    # Validate time
    if not (0 <= hh <= 23 and 0 <= mm <= 59):
        return np.nan
    return hh * 60 + mm

start_min = dT["STRTTIME"].apply(hhmm_to_minutes)
end_min   = dT["ENDTIME"].apply(hhmm_to_minutes)

# --- 3) Compute per-trip duration in minutes with midnight wrap
# (end - start) % 1440 gives 0..1439 minutes; handles trips crossing midnight
dT["TravelTimeMinutes"] = (end_min - start_min) % (24 * 60)

# Optional: if you want to treat identical times as missing instead of 0:
# dT.loc[(~start_min.isna()) & (~end_min.isna()) & (start_min == end_min), "TravelTimeMinutes"] = np.nan

# --- 4) Recompute total per TOURID and merge back
tour_time = (
    dT.groupby("TOURID", as_index=False)
      .agg(TotalTravelTimeMinutes=("TravelTimeMinutes", "sum"))
)
dT = dT.merge(tour_time, on="TOURID", how="left")

# --- 5) (Optional) sanity checks
print(dT["TravelTimeMinutes"].describe())            # should be 0..1439 now, no negatives
```
```{python}
# --- Ensure numeric and handle missing ---
dT["DWELTIME"] = pd.to_numeric(dT.get("DWELTIME"), errors="coerce").fillna(0)

# (You already have this from earlier; shown for clarity)
# dT["TravelTimeMinutes"] = ...  # per-trip travel duration in minutes (0..1439)

# --- 1) Total *activity* time per tour (sum of DWELTIME) ---
dT["TotalActivityTimeMinutes"] = (
    dT.groupby("TOURID")["DWELTIME"].transform("sum")
)

# Compute per-TOURID total directly onto dT (no merge needed)
dT["TotalTravelTimeMinutes"] = (
    dT.groupby("TOURID")["TravelTimeMinutes"].transform("sum")
)

# --- (Optional) Total tour time budget = activity + travel ---
dT["TourTimeMinutes"] = (
    dT["TotalActivityTimeMinutes"] + dT["TotalTravelTimeMinutes"]
)

# --- Quick sanity checks ---
# Should be 1 unique value per TOURID for each total
assert dT.groupby("TOURID")["TotalActivityTimeMinutes"].nunique().eq(1).all()
assert dT.groupby("TOURID")["TotalTravelTimeMinutes"].nunique().eq(1).all()

# Inspect a few columns
print(
    dT[["TOURID", "TRIPID", "TravelTimeMinutes", "DWELTIME",
        "TotalTravelTimeMinutes", "TotalActivityTimeMinutes",
        "TourTimeMinutes"]].head()
)


print([c for c in dT.columns if "TourTimeMinutes" in c])
```

```{python}
# --- Define bins and labels for total travel time ---
bins = [0, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180, 210, 240, 270, 300, 330, 360, 390, 420, 450, 480, 510, 540, 570, 600, 630, 660, 690,720, float('inf')]
labels = [
    '0–30', '30–60','60–90', '90–120','120–150', '150–180', '180–210', '210–240', '240–270', '270–300', '300–330','330–360',
    '360–390', '390–420','420–450', '450–480', '480–510', '510–540', '540–570', '570–600', '600–630', '630–660', '660–690', '690–720', '720+'
]

# --- Apply categorical binning ---
dT['TourTimeCategory'] = pd.cut(
    dT['TourTimeMinutes'],
    bins=bins,
    labels=labels,
    right=False
)

# --- Count frequency per category ---
category_counts = dT['TourTimeCategory'].value_counts().sort_index()

# --- Plot histogram ---
plt.figure(figsize=(8, 4))
sns.barplot(x=category_counts.index, y=category_counts.values, color='skyblue')
plt.xlabel("Total Tour Duration (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("Count of Tours")
plt.title("Distribution of Total Tour Duration Categories")
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

```{python}
dT = dT[dT["TourTimeMinutes"] <= 720].copy()

# Measure after
after = len(dT)
print(f"Removed {before - after} rows ({before} → {after}).")
```

```{python}
# --- 3) Quartiles as labels on IncHouseh ---
# duplicates="drop" prevents errors if many equal values land on a boundary
dT = dT.copy()
dT["inc_quant"] = pd.qcut(dT["IncHouseh"], q=4, labels=['Q1','Q2','Q3','Q4'], duplicates='drop')

# --- 4) Count unique sessions/households by quartile ---
# Use SessionId if available; else fall back to HOUSEID; else just count rows.
if "SessionId" in dT.columns:
    key_col = "SessionId"
elif "HOUSEID" in dT.columns:
    key_col = "HOUSEID"
else:
    key_col = None

if key_col is not None:
    session_counts = (
        dT.groupby("inc_quant")[key_col]
          .nunique()
          .reset_index(name="UniqueSessions")
    )
else:
    session_counts = (
        dT.groupby("inc_quant")
          .size()
          .reset_index(name="UniqueSessions")
    )

total_sessions = session_counts["UniqueSessions"].sum()
session_counts["Percentage"] = (session_counts["UniqueSessions"] / total_sessions * 100).round(2)

print(session_counts)
```

#Mode
```{python}
# Ensure TRPTRANS is numeric
dT["TRPTRANS"] = pd.to_numeric(dT["TRPTRANS"], errors="coerce")

# Codes to drop
drop_codes = [-7, -8, -9, 7, 9, 10, 13, 19, 97]

# Remove unwanted rows
dT = dT[~dT["TRPTRANS"].isin(drop_codes)].copy()

# Create TRIPMODE
dT["TRIPMODE"] = pd.NA

dT.loc[dT["TRPTRANS"] == 1, "TRIPMODE"] = "Walk"
dT.loc[dT["TRPTRANS"] == 2, "TRIPMODE"] = "Bicycle"

# Car modes
car_codes = [3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 18]
dT.loc[dT["TRPTRANS"].isin(car_codes), "TRIPMODE"] = "Car"

# Transit modes
transit_codes = [11, 12, 14, 15, 16, 17, 20]
dT.loc[dT["TRPTRANS"].isin(transit_codes), "TRIPMODE"] = "Transit"

# Check result
print(dT["TRIPMODE"].value_counts(dropna=False))

print(sorted(dT.loc[dT["TRIPMODE"].isna(), "TRPTRANS"].unique()))
```
```{python}
# 0) Make sure these are in good shape
dT["TravelTimeMinutes"] = pd.to_numeric(dT["TravelTimeMinutes"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
# TRIPMODE should already be one of: "Walk", "Bicycle", "Car", "Transit" (or NA)

# 1) Sum travel time by TOURID × TRIPMODE
mode_time = (
    dT.dropna(subset=["TRIPMODE"])  # ignore trips with unknown mode for PRIMMODE
      .groupby(["TOURID", "TRIPMODE"], dropna=False)["TravelTimeMinutes"]
      .sum()
      .reset_index(name="ModeTravelTimeMinutes")
)

# 2) Tie-break rule (you can customize this order)
#    If two modes have the same summed time, prefer Transit > Car > Bicycle > Walk
precedence = {"Transit": 1, "Car": 2, "Bicycle": 3, "Walk": 4}
mode_time["mode_rank"] = mode_time["TRIPMODE"].map(precedence).fillna(99).astype(int)

# 3) Pick the primary mode per TOURID
PRIMMODE_per_tour = (
    mode_time.sort_values(
        ["TOURID", "ModeTravelTimeMinutes", "mode_rank"],
        ascending=[True, False, True]
    )
    .drop_duplicates(subset=["TOURID"], keep="first")
    .rename(columns={"TRIPMODE": "PRIMMODE"})
    [["TOURID", "PRIMMODE"]]
)

# 4) Attach PRIMMODE back to all trips in the tour
dT = dT.merge(PRIMMODE_per_tour, on="TOURID", how="left")

# --- Optional fallbacks ---
# If a tour has all trips with unknown TRIPMODE or all 0 minutes,
# PRIMMODE will be NaN. You can optionally fill those with the most
# frequent mode by count (if you prefer), like this:

if dT["PRIMMODE"].isna().any():
    # Most frequent mode by trip count within the tour as a fallback
    mode_count = (
        dT.dropna(subset=["TRIPMODE"])
          .groupby(["TOURID", "TRIPMODE"]).size()
          .reset_index(name="n")
    )
    mode_count["mode_rank"] = mode_count["TRIPMODE"].map(precedence).fillna(99).astype(int)
    PRIMMODE_fallback = (
        mode_count.sort_values(["TOURID", "n", "mode_rank"], ascending=[True, False, True])
                  .drop_duplicates("TOURID")[["TOURID", "TRIPMODE"]]
                  .rename(columns={"TRIPMODE": "PRIMMODE_fallback"})
    )
    dT = dT.merge(PRIMMODE_fallback, on="TOURID", how="left")
    dT["PRIMMODE"] = dT["PRIMMODE"].fillna(dT["PRIMMODE_fallback"])
    dT = dT.drop(columns=["PRIMMODE_fallback"], errors="ignore")

# Quick checks
print(dT[["TOURID", "TRIPMODE", "TravelTimeMinutes", "PRIMMODE"]].head())
print(dT["PRIMMODE"].value_counts(dropna=False))
```

#	Purpose of tour (the purpose of the longest staying time of the tour)
```{python}
# Ensure WHYTRP1S is numeric
dT["WHYTRP1S"] = pd.to_numeric(dT["WHYTRP1S"], errors="coerce")

# Codes to drop
drop_codes = [1, 20, 97]

# Remove unwanted rows
dT = dT[~dT["WHYTRP1S"].isin(drop_codes)].copy()

# Create TRIPPURP
dT["TRIPPURP"] = pd.NA

dT.loc[dT["WHYTRP1S"] == 10, "TRIPPURP"] = "Work"
dT.loc[dT["WHYTRP1S"] == 70, "TRIPPURP"] = "Chauffeuring"

Shoppingerrands_codes = [30, 40]
dT.loc[dT["WHYTRP1S"].isin(Shoppingerrands_codes), "TRIPPURP"] = "ShoppingErrands"

leisuresocial_codes = [50, 80]
dT.loc[dT["WHYTRP1S"].isin(leisuresocial_codes), "TRIPPURP"] = "LeisureSocial"

# Check result
print(dT["TRIPPURP"].value_counts(dropna=False))

print(sorted(dT.loc[dT["TRIPPURP"].isna(), "WHYTRP1S"].unique()))
```
```{python}
# 0) Ensure inputs are clean
dT["DWELTIME"]  = pd.to_numeric(dT["DWELTIME"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
# TRIPPURP already created in your code: Work / Chauffeuring / ShoppingErrands / LeisureSocial (or NA)

# 1) Sum activity time by TOURID × TRIPPURP
purp_time = (
    dT.dropna(subset=["TRIPPURP"])  # ignore unknown purpose rows for PRIMPURP
      .groupby(["TOURID", "TRIPPURP"], dropna=False)["DWELTIME"]
      .sum()
      .reset_index(name="PurpActivityTimeMinutes")
)

# 2) Tie-break rule when totals tie (customize as you like)
#    Example precedence: Work > Chauffeuring > ShoppingErrands > LeisureSocial
purp_precedence = {"Work": 1, "Chauffeuring": 2, "ShoppingErrands": 3, "LeisureSocial": 4}
purp_time["purp_rank"] = purp_time["TRIPPURP"].map(purp_precedence).fillna(99).astype(int)

# 3) Pick the primary purpose per TOURID
primpurp_per_tour = (
    purp_time.sort_values(
        ["TOURID", "PurpActivityTimeMinutes", "purp_rank"],
        ascending=[True, False, True]
    )
    .drop_duplicates(subset=["TOURID"], keep="first")
    .rename(columns={"TRIPPURP": "PRIMPURP"})
    [["TOURID", "PRIMPURP"]]
)

# 4) Attach PRIMPURP back to all trips in the tour
dT = dT.merge(primpurp_per_tour, on="TOURID", how="left")

# --- Optional fallback(s) ---
# If a tour has only NA TRIPPURP (or all DWELTIME == 0), PRIMPURP can be NA.
# Fallback 1: choose the most frequent TRIPPURP within the tour (with same precedence).
if dT["PRIMPURP"].isna().any():
    purp_count = (
        dT.dropna(subset=["TRIPPURP"])
          .groupby(["TOURID", "TRIPPURP"]).size()
          .reset_index(name="n")
    )
    purp_count["purp_rank"] = purp_count["TRIPPURP"].map(purp_precedence).fillna(99).astype(int)
    primpurp_fb = (
        purp_count.sort_values(["TOURID", "n", "purp_rank"], ascending=[True, False, True])
                  .drop_duplicates("TOURID")[["TOURID", "TRIPPURP"]]
                  .rename(columns={"TRIPPURP": "PRIMPURP_fb"})
    )
    dT = dT.merge(primpurp_fb, on="TOURID", how="left")
    dT["PRIMPURP"] = dT["PRIMPURP"].fillna(dT["PRIMPURP_fb"])
    dT.drop(columns=["PRIMPURP_fb"], inplace=True, errors="ignore")

# --- Diagnostics ---
print(dT[["TOURID","TRIPID","TRIPPURP","DWELTIME","PRIMPURP"]].head())
print(dT["PRIMPURP"].value_counts(dropna=False))
```
